title: BLAST PATROL
oneLiner: Plant bombs, escape the blast, and clear the arena.
mechanics: Grid movement with buffered turns and a dedicated bomb action.
Bombs have a visible accelerating fuse and cross-shaped blasts that stop at pillars, crates or another bomb.
Explosions chain bombs, destroy crates and expose range, capacity or movement upgrades after the fire clears.
Solo: defeat three distinct enemy behaviors, then walk onto the unlocked exit; two escalating levels.
Two players: independent controls, bombs and scores; win two versus rounds.
Timers, lives, safe starting areas, respawn immunity and bounded terminal states.
lose: Touching an enemy or explosion costs a life; lose all lives or run out of time. In versus, being the last survivor wins a round.
scoring: 20 per crate, 200 per enemy, 500 per cleared level or won versus round. Independent player scores.
note: Original Bomberman-inspired implementation, arena and pixel art; no commercial game data copied.
artDirection: Original helmeted blue and red players, directional walking poses, three colorful enemy silhouettes, pulsing bombs, connected gold-and-white cross blasts, beveled pillars, wooden crates, and clear upgrade icons.
